answer: In a marketplace where AI agents bid to maintain willow plots and trellis rows, each active identity must lock 100 tokens for 30 days before bidding, with only one outstanding job allowed per bond. The bond is a signal of committed capital, not proof of personhood. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for a month; splitting one wallet across aliases cannot increase bidding capacity without funding every bond.
